claim_scope: Developability-only compensation on Jain 2017. Affinity/potency is absent and explicitly out of scope.
control_ranker: Equal-weight mean of direction-aligned z-scores over the gated assays in each fold. z_ij=d_j*(x_ij-mean_j)/sample_sd_j; d_j=+1 when larger is favorable and -1 when smaller is favorable. Statistics use the complete-case assay matrix only, before status labels are read. Ties break by candidate_id ascending.
cohort_rule: Complete case across all 10 Table-1 thresholded assays. No imputation. Fab_Tm and transient_HEK_titer excluded from confirmatory scoring and gating.

jain_evaluation.rule: The held-out group is excluded from both ranking and Receipt Gate eligibility in that fold and used only for orthogonal survivor evaluation. Published Jain group assignments and thresholds are frozen; no outcome-driven reassignment.

correlation_rule: Publish pairwise Spearman assay correlations with |rho|>=0.70 before status labels are read. Correlation is descriptive and cannot modify the frozen policy. Headline liabilities are candidate-level property-group flags so correlated assays are not counted as independent wins.

primary_success_criteria.masked_liability_reduction: treatment rate <= control rate - 0.10 in >=3/4 folds at 25% budget
primary_success_criteria.yield: treatment top_k_fill_rate >=0.80 in >=3/4 folds and pooled >=0.80 at 25% budget
primary_success_criteria.heldout_quality: treatment heldout flag rate <= control +0.05 in >=3/4 folds and pooled treatment <= pooled control at 25% budget

decision_rule: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE only if every primary criterion passes. If masked liabilities fall but yield or held-out quality fails, verdict is FRICTION_ONLY. If the frozen composite baseline does not expose the preregistered compensation signal, verdict is NO_COMPENSATION_SIGNAL. Secondary budgets cannot rescue the primary verdict.
authority_control: A threshold-constrained ranker using identical vetoes and identical score must match Receipt Gate selection on clean historical rows. Expected parity narrows the unique OpenLine claim to receiver-owned authority and evidence/receipt enforcement, not superior scoring.
zero_variance_rule: A gated assay with sample SD 0 contributes z=0 to every composite score but remains subject to its frozen hard veto.
